summary: By default the operator provisions storage dynamically; with static provisioning you create PVs and PVCs first and the operator binds to PVCs matching its names, and because PVCs survive deletion, redeploying with the same name reconnects to the data.
questions: How does static provisioning work with the AAP Operator?
Does deleting the AAP instance delete its PVCs?
Redeploy AAP and keep the existing data
